LinkedIn User.Title: Data Collection and Storage
LinkedIn User.Description: Implement functionalities to scrape first-level LinkedIn contacts, create an ignore list using NLP, store conversation history, and upload data for personalized messaging. This includes creating a UI for managing the ignore list and storing all data in local JSON files.

LinkedIn User.Title: Contact Analysis and Message Generation
LinkedIn User.Description: Develop features to analyze LinkedIn contact profiles using OpenAI NLP, generate personalized initial and follow-up messages based on conversation history and profile analysis, and store these messages with approval tracking keys.

LinkedIn User.Title: User Interface for Message Approval
LinkedIn User.Description: Create a user-friendly interface for reviewing and approving generated messages. This UI should allow users to update the approval status of initial and follow-up messages, ensuring control over the communication being sent out.

LinkedIn User.Title: Campaign Management
LinkedIn User.Description: Build functionalities for users to create and manage campaigns, filter contacts by various criteria, set system contexts for transformers, and view historical campaigns. This includes a UI for campaign creation and management.

LinkedIn User.Title: Managing Potential Contacts
LinkedIn User.Description: Implement features to create new contact lists based on specific criteria from LinkedIn searches, invite potential contacts programmatically, and track the status of these invitations. This includes storing potential contacts in a local JSON file and recording invite dates.

LinkedIn User.Title: Automated Follow-Up and Outreach
LinkedIn User.Description: Develop functionalities to send follow-up messages automatically if no response is received to the initial message after 48 hours, track pending invitations, and use LinkedIn Sales Navigator for outreach to invited contacts who haven't accepted the connection request.

LinkedIn User.Title: Dashboard and Settings Management
LinkedIn User.Description: Design a modern dashboard to display key metrics such as the total number of contacts and messages sent. Implement a settings section where users can adjust message sending limits, invitation limits, follow-up message limits, and provide necessary inputs like OpenAI API key and Chrome browser path.
